BOB · ILLUSTRATION SET

Bob, drawn small

Eleven interactive illustrations for the Bob site: a small language that opens a little world with make--> and closes it with <--. Everything here is inline SVG, CSS and JavaScript in one file.

0 is not 00

06 · Inline versus explicit

          
Commas, or make--> and <--

          
Inline: the first element is the parent and commas add its children; the line ends the parent. Blocks: make--> opens and <-- closes. Indentation is for readers, not scope.

07 · Click

          
Read the box, update the greeting

          
Type a name and press the button. Bob handles the click, reads name_box, and replaces the heading text. Click is the supported event.

          
          
          

            
            
          

          

        

        

          
        

      

    

    

      

        

          
08 · Styling modifiers

          
Say it after the colon

          
Toggle a modifier: text colour, bg, a quoted font, a size in rem, or bold. Bob supports this small set, not all of CSS.

          

          

        

        

          
        

      

    

    

      

        

          
09 · One output or three

          
One file, or --split

          
By default CSS and JavaScript sit inside one HTML file. --split aims to write index.html, style.css and script.js into a folder.

          

          

        

        

          
        

      

    

    

      

        

          
10 · Strings

          
One line, or many

          
Triple quotes keep newlines and indentation. Bob commands inside stay literal text.

          

          

        

        

          
        

      

    

    

      

        

          
11 · Bob-authored SVG

          
A circle inside an svg root

          
SVG tags are ordinary Bob elements. The root gets its namespace automatically; the circle is self-closing.
